properties.displayName: Key Vaults must use RBAC authorization and deny public network access
properties.description: Denies creation or update of a Key Vault that uses the legacy access-policy authorization model instead of Azure RBAC, or that leaves public network access enabled. Enforces the pattern this lab builds: per-secret RBAC scoping and network isolation by default. Set to Audit during rollout, Deny once existing vaults are remediated.

metadata.description: Audit while assessing existing vaults; switch to Deny once remediated.
